rid.en: Getting rid of clutter makes us feel uplifted – cheerful, happy and more positive.
rid.zh: 摆脱杂物让我们感到振奋——快乐、高兴且更积极。

rid.en: They would do almost anything to be rid of their oppressor, and Hannibal was ready to take full advantage.
rid.zh: 为了摆脱压迫者，他们愿意付出一切代价，而Hannibal已经准备好充分利用这一点。

rid.en: Unpack here means explain. Sonja explains that when our skin feels itchy, we scratch it, and that helps to get rid of parasites and other harmful things on our skin.
rid.zh: 这里的 unpack 意思是'解释、阐明'。Sonja 解释说，当皮肤感到痒时，我们会去挠它，这有助于清除皮肤上的寄生虫和其他有害物质。

rid.en: Throughout the 16th, 17th and 18th centuries, inventors continued to tinker away on new versions of this technology, trying to solve the problem of how to get rid of exhaled air, have enough capacity for fresh air, and maintain the right pressure at the same time.
rid.zh: 在16、17和18世纪，发明家们继续摆弄这项技术的新版本，试图解决如何排除呼出的气体、拥有足够的新鲜空气容量以及同时维持正确压力的难题。

rise.en: They believed that property values would always rise, houses would always become more expensive.
rise.zh: 他们坚信房地产价值永远会上涨，房子只会越来越贵。

rise.en: There are shortages in countries around the world, and oil prices have risen sharply.
rise.zh: 世界各地的国家都出现了短缺，油价急剧上涨。

rise.en: But first, our quiz question. World leaders promised in 2015 to limit global temperature rises.
rise.zh: 但首先，是我们的问答环节。世界领导人在 2015 年承诺限制全球气温上升。

rise.en: His political rise was not stellar, but he was rewarded with increasing responsibility.
rise.zh: 他的仕途虽然不算飞黄腾达，但也稳步上升，承担的责任越来越重。

rise.en: The rise of nationalism and euroscepticism in some countries also threatens the EU.
rise.zh: 一些国家民族主义和欧洲怀疑主义的抬头也对欧盟构成了威胁。

risk.en: Some people are naturally more outgoing, naturally more comfortable taking risks than other people.
risk.zh: 有些人天生更外向，天生比其他人更乐意冒风险。

risk.en: Earthquake risk is another serious concern, as the city sits near major fault lines.
risk.zh: 地震风险是另一个严重的问题，因为该市靠近主要断层线。

risk.en: He was drowning in debt, and was at risk of having to declare personal bankruptcy.
risk.zh: 他债台高筑，面临着不得不宣布个人破产的风险。

risk.en: We’ll look at the benefits, at the risks, and at the ethical questions surrounding surveillance.
risk.zh: 我们将探讨监控带来的好处、风险以及围绕监控的伦理问题。

risk.en: Excessive risk taking, overconfidence, lack of regulation, and a sudden loss of trust.
risk.zh: 过度冒险、过度自信、缺乏监管以及信任的突然丧失。

rib.en: And then we have to give a shout-out to activist groups like Greenpeace, who put their RIB boats – they put their Zodiacs in between Soviet hunting vessels and sperm whales.
rib.zh: 在这里我们也不得不为绿色和平这样的行动团体点个赞(shout-out)，他们把自己的充气艇——他们的 Zodiac 快艇——直接开到苏联捕鲸船和抹香鲸之间。

ridiculous.en: They both named their dog 'Toy'. It was, like, ridiculous!
ridiculous.zh: 他们都给自己的狗起名叫“玩具”。这简直太荒谬了！

ridiculous.en: They also argue that children do not read puppet violence in the same way adults do: the violence is stylised, ridiculous, and obviously unreal.
ridiculous.zh: 他们还认为，儿童对木偶暴力的解读与成年人不同：这种暴力是风格化的、荒谬的、显然是不真实的。

ridiculous.en: Jayne definitely belongs to this group, as she explains to BBC Radio 4’s, Woman’s Hour: I think I'd had some really bad experiences at baby groups where you're trying to make your child do yoga or paint when they're four months old, and trying to bond with these other women and I just thought, ‘This is ridiculous!’ And I pretty much straight away realised it was gonna be just down to luck if I met somebody that I clicked with.
ridiculous.zh: 杰恩显然属于后一种，正如她向 BBC 第四台《女性时间》节目所解释的那样：我想我之前在育儿小组里有过一些非常糟糕的经历，当孩子四个月大的时候，你得让他们学瑜伽或画画，还要努力和这些女人搞好关系，我当时就想：“这太荒谬了！”我几乎立刻就意识到，能不能遇到一个合得来的人全凭运气。

rigid.en: I unknowingly did my best to adhere to what we call the 'man box', which is a kind of rigid set of ideals and rules that I may feel pressure as a boy to follow, in order to be a quote unquote 'real man'.
rigid.zh: 我在不知不觉中，努力去遵循我们所说的'男人框框'('man box')——那是一套僵化的理念和规则，作为一个男孩，我可能会感到有压力去遵守，才能成为所谓的'真正的男人'。

rival.en: That created an opportunity for France, who were one of Portugal’s biggest European rivals.
rival.zh: 这为法国创造了机会，法国是葡萄牙在欧洲最大的竞争对手之一。

rival.en: Rival princes who had not been caught up in the Ritz-Carlton purge suddenly found themselves silenced.
rival.zh: 那些没有在丽思卡尔顿大清洗中落网的敌对亲王们突然发现自己被噤声了。

rival.en: In the 1440s, Sforza was hired by the city of Milan to defend it against its rivals.
rival.zh: 在1440年代，斯福尔扎被米兰城雇佣来保卫其免受竞争对手的侵害。

rival.en: Britain and France were fierce rivals at this time.
rival.zh: 当时英国和法国是死敌。

rival.en: They also included places that were maybe his rivals, places like Brazil, or I think Uruguay was on that list as well.
rival.zh: 它们还包括可能是他的竞争对手的地方，比如巴西，或者我想乌拉圭也在那个名单上。

ripe.en: The oldest recorded person ever to have lived was a woman who was born in 1875, and lived to the ripe old age of 122.
ripe.zh: 有记录以来最长寿的人是一位生于1875年的女性，她活到了122岁的高龄。

ripe.en: Tiberius was 77 years old, which was a ripe old age at this time, and there is simply no evidence to suggest it was anything other than natural causes.
ripe.zh: Tiberius 享年77岁，在当时这已经是高寿了，而且根本没有证据表明这是自然死亡之外的任何原因。

ripe.en: She died of natural causes in 1747 at the ripe old age of 77 but with no living descendants to fight to clear her name, legally speaking, she was still a witch.
ripe.zh: 她在1747年以77岁的高龄寿终正寝，由于没有健在的后代来为她奔走平反，从法律上讲，她依然是个女巫。

ripe.en: Whether it is an autocratic leader, an unsympathetic elite, widespread famine, police brutality, systemic corruption, high unemployment, runaway inflation, the lack of political freedom or some combination of any or all of these, it’s easy for historians to look back and say, “the conditions were ripe for revolution”.
ripe.zh: 无论是专制领导人、冷漠的精英阶层、普遍的饥荒、警察暴力、系统性腐败、高失业率、恶性通货膨胀、缺乏政治自由，还是其中任何或全部因素的组合，历史学家都很容易回过头来说：“革命的条件已经成熟。”

rifle.en: They are teenagers, trained by Tanzanian military advisers and armed with AK-47 rifles.
rifle.zh: 他们都是十几岁的青少年，由坦桑尼亚军事顾问训练，配备着 AK-47 步枪。

ritual.en: The Shang rulers controlled territory, they had armies and they performed religious rituals.
ritual.zh: 商朝统治者控制领土，他们拥有军队并举行宗教仪式。

ritual.en: And, of course, there are symbolic rituals, oaths, and, famously, secret handshakes.
ritual.zh: 当然，还有象征性的仪式、誓言，以及著名的秘密握手方式。

ritual.en: Daily life involved fishing and farming, tool making, and religious rituals.
ritual.zh: 日常生活包括捕鱼和耕作、制造工具以及宗教仪式。

ritual.en: It's a patchwork of rituals, culture, and history.
ritual.zh: 它是由仪式、文化和历史拼凑而成的。

ritual.en: By focusing on rituals and an elite membership, it cemented its reputation as a group that was as mysterious as it was influential.
ritual.zh: 通过专注于仪式和精英成员，它巩固了自己作为一个既神秘又具影响力的团体的声誉。

ridicule.en: We know that Caligula loved playing jokes and had a devilish sense of humour, and it seems much more probable that either he was planning on doing this to ridicule his senators, or that he made a passing comment along the lines of “so and so is so useless that my horse could govern better than they could”.
ridicule.zh: 我们知道 Caligula 喜欢开玩笑，并且有着恶魔般的幽默感，似乎更有可能是他当时正计划这样做来羞辱他的元老院议员，或者他只是顺口说了一句类似“某某某太废物了，我的马都比他治理得好”这样的话。

riot.en: Tourism was practically dead, foreign investors had bolted, and bread lines were sparking riots.
riot.zh: 旅游业几乎瘫痪，外国投资者逃之夭夭，排队买面包引发了骚乱。

riot.en: In 2024, recently, there were deadly riots after France introduced a policy to change electoral rules.
riot.zh: 就在2024年最近，在法国推出一项旨在改变选举规则的政策后，爆发了致命的骚乱。

riot.en: Strikes, demonstrations, and riots became common.
riot.zh: 罢工、游行和暴动变得屡见不鲜。

riot.en: Singapore is majority Chinese. In 1964, racial riots broke out in Singapore between Malay and Chinese communities, resulting in deaths and injuries.
riot.zh: 新加坡是以华人为主的。1964年，新加坡爆发了马来族和华人社群之间的种族骚乱，导致了人员伤亡。

rig.en: But the problem was that Mubarak had spent decades rigging the game, leaving only token opposition.
rig.zh: 但问题在于，Mubarak 花了几十年时间操纵这场游戏，只留下象征性的反对派。

ripple.en: Now, fast forward to 1914. The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria, in the now Bosnian capital of Sarajevo, had ripple effects that extended all the way to the Arabian desert.
ripple.zh: 现在，时间快进到 1914 年。奥地利大公 Franz Ferdinand 在现在的波斯尼亚首都萨拉热窝遇刺，其连锁反应一直延伸到了阿拉伯沙漠。

rip.en: A vote for Labour is a vote to rip up the Conservatives’ plan, to return to square one, and what’s more, square one without a plan about how to move forward.
rip.zh: 投票给工党就是投票撕毁保守党的计划，回到原点，而且更糟糕的是，回到一个没有前进计划的原点。
